findings.title: Legacy graph is not a Freya write payload
findings.detail: freya_workflow emits nodes/edges arrays, a synthetic start node, type/data fields and a variables declaration. Freya requires initial_node plus a node-keyed object containing node_type, task_message and per-node transitions. The emitter explicitly calls its output an unverified mapping. check_workflow validates only that legacy mapping; a passing result does not establish Freya compatibility.
findings.adapter: Emit the documented bare workflow from AgentSpec directly; keep provenance in a separate artifact and validate the official shape.

findings.title: Condition syntax and collection gates change behavior
findings.detail: The emitter uses gt/lt/gte/lte and value; Freya documents greater_than/less_than and operand. Variable checks should be in a top-level OR, with AND nested inside it. slots_filled is emitted without any condition. confirmed/rejected pass the spec grammar but runtime._holds never implements them. Boolean equality is unsafe because Freya compares string representations.
findings.adapter: Compile slots_filled to an AND of is_set checks inside OR; translate operators, use explicit string status flags, and implement or reject confirmed/rejected. For integer attempts>=N use greater_than N-1; for general numeric >=/<= use normalized code predicates or a tested compound condition.

evidence.note: Legacy condition conversion and unconditional slots_filled.
Official operators, grouping and boolean caveat.

findings.title: Tools have names and slot arguments but no deployable binding
findings.detail: Tool holds only name, args, provenance, event, constraints and side_effect. The emitter creates data.function/args/preconditions/outputs without a handler, URL, HTTP method, JSON-schema body or response mapping. The kit requires function wrappers with __function__:api_call or code_exec and leaf defaults under parameters.properties.body.properties.
findings.adapter: Add a separate tool registry keyed by semantic tool name: server/path/method, request fields and sources, enums/required fields, response schema, success predicate, execution placement, timeout/retry policy. Bind names against the supplied OpenAPI; do not assume a matching name alone is sufficient.

findings.title: Existing mock contract does not establish kit tool correctness
findings.detail: mock_tools verifies a combined dob/id_last4 argument set against local CRM facts, compares only the first five DOB characters, and returns success for other tools. The kit verify_identity accepts customer_id, field and answer, with field=date_of_birth or phone_last4; get_account requires both answers to pass. HTTP 200 can still contain ok=false. Existing save_promise naming in tests must explicitly bind to create_promise, with customer_id/product_id/amount/date. Mock success/events cannot stand in for real API response semantics.
findings.adapter: Use exact OpenAPI requests and a result envelope containing status/data/status_code. Distinguish transport success, data.ok, individual verified and aggregate all_verified; derive events only from the intended business predicate. Normalize dates to ISO and use synthetic fixtures for full-date mismatch, rejected answers and multiple products.

evidence.note: Mock identity first-five-character comparison and default success.
Success sets event and clears attempts.
Promise request schema and business ok.
API result envelope and data-prefixed mappings.

findings.title: Extraction, prompt interpolation and call inputs need conversion
findings.detail: The emitter's amount:number/date:string and collect/enum fields are not Freya extraction_schema types and enum_values. node_prompt preserves single-brace {fact}/{slot} text while local runtime uses str.format; Freya uses double braces. spec.facts values are available locally but emitted input variables carry no values. Dates emitted as strings lose Freya's relative-date anchor.
findings.adapter: Keep JSON-schema request types separate from extraction types: amount->float, date->date, digits4->string with validation_pattern, yesno->boolean, text->string; specify descriptions and min_confidence. Translate known IR placeholders safely into Freya prompts. Supply per-call inputs through customerVariablesMap, use explicit setup code for derived facts, and avoid serializing private CRM answers as prompts or defaults.

evidence.note: Call variable sources and Freya interpolation.
Extraction types, enum_values, confidence and date anchor.

findings.title: Confirmation, constraints and joins are mostly runtime-only
findings.detail: The local runtime waits for read-back confirmation, enforces numeric constraints before a tool call, and blocks joins using successful-tool trace entries. The emitted preconditions are descriptive strings, outputs are declarations, and join uses undocumented condition nodes with all/not_all/waitsOn/parallel. A prompt request to confirm is not equivalent to the runtime's gate.
findings.adapter: Lower explicit confirmation and correction states, validate constraints before entering any engine-run write action, and derive string success flags from actual responses. Compile join gates as nested AND or code predicates. Serialize independent checks unless concurrent execution is separately established; config.interruptible=false is documented asynchronous behavior, not a general join/parallel schema.

evidence.note: Pre-call confirmation, join and numeric constraint enforcement.

findings.title: Retry counters and loop limits need semantic lowering
findings.detail: Legacy emission adds increment metadata to tool nodes and declarations for <node>_attempts; a bounded collection node without a tool declares but never sets its counter. Local runtime separately counts unanswered collection turns and failed calls, resets successful attempts and clears rejected inputs. Freya max_node_turns counts user turns only and needs max_turn_transition to enforce an exit. Built-in tool counters do not by themselves encode these policies or business-answer failures.
findings.adapter: Specify whether each budget counts wrong answers, malformed answers, transport failures, unanswered turns or total visits. Use business response fields such as wrong_answers_left and explicit code state where needed; add a finite turn-cap fallback and ensure passthrough nodes have default targets and final always transitions.

evidence.note: Increment emitted only for tool actions.
Success reset, failure increment and clearing slots.
Malformed DOB is not a wrong-answer attempt.

findings.title: Local and Freya routing priority differ
findings.detail: WorkflowRuntime.on_user evaluates global intent edges before local intent edges and before slot extraction. Freya extracts first and then checks loop/current-node transitions before global handlers. A naive adapter that puts global_edges into global_nodes while leaving an unconditional local fallback can starve those interrupts; priority equivalence requires a deliberate design.
findings.adapter: Define desired interrupt precedence, lower interrupt checks before broad local fallbacks where necessary, and explicitly gate local progress. Use global handlers for genuine interrupts with terminal/excluded_nodes protection. Test competing intents, slot completion plus escalation and same-turn tool-result routing.

evidence.note: Freya evaluation priority and result routing.

findings.title: Ending and transfer do not implement the kit ledger contract
findings.detail: Legacy end uses agent.data.endCall; transfer uses type=transfer with target/message. Runtime sets done without calling the bank backend. Freya end_call needs terminal.__function__:end_call, with farewell configured there. The kit additionally exposes transfer_to_agent(customer_id,queue) and close_call(customer_id,outcome,reason); close_call must be the final bank tool, and reason is required except promise/paid. The base example uses an end_of_call lifecycle close_call tool.
findings.adapter: Lower terminal states separately from backend transfer/close actions. Record transfer through the supplied HTTP operation, set outcome/reason deterministically, and run exactly one final close_call using an appropriate lifecycle tool or a guarded final action. Use the full OpenAPI enum rather than the base example's reduced subset.

evidence.note: Terminal states stop without backend actions.
Last-call close contract, outcomes and conditional reason.

findings.title: Simulation artifacts are incomplete for the kit's workflow
findings.detail: freya_simulation emits mode=voice with placeholder agent/persona IDs, runsPerPersona and tags; it omits customerVariablesMap, model overrides and duration/concurrency. The kit's reference loop uses chat and explicit dialogue/routing/extraction overrides. This is a readiness gap for the kit, not evidence that Freya never supports voice. Persona core fields match the kit; optional agentIds is not confirmed by the supplied local persona documentation. The unit-test emitter's endpoint/schema is not covered by these kit docs.
findings.adapter: Resolve IDs after persona/workflow creation, map official per-persona call variables, select chat for the documented local review loop and supply all required overrides. Preserve configurable k; note freya.run_simulation currently hardcodes runsPerPersona=1. Treat unit-test payloads and optional persona fields as unverified until separately documented.

evidence.note: Matching persona core fields and optional agentIds.
Simulation inputs and all three overrides.

findings.title: Multi-agent export uses undocumented state and handback fields
findings.detail: freya_multiagent_workflow retains the invalid graph schema, dotted node IDs and agents/context/handoff/handback/setVariables/targetVariable metadata. The kit documents a single call-wide variable table and string target_node, with __previous__ for global returns; it does not document dynamic targetVariable or native multi-agent invocation for this workflow subset. Bare shared intent/event/slot names can collide across agents.
findings.adapter: Flatten specialist AgentSpecs into a single official node map with stable snake_case names and explicit variable namespace/ownership. Implement static return branches or genuine global __previous__ returns, and translate carried state explicitly. Do not advertise native invoke_agent or generic dynamic return behavior from this mapping.

evidence.note: Legacy topology export and dynamic handback.

findings.title: The external stream guard is not deployed by a workflow JSON
findings.detail: The runtime applies StreamGuard and an optional semantic judge before speech. write_all emits guard_policy.yaml alongside the graph but does not attach that guard to Freya. The supplied workflow subset has no documented per-token TTS interception; lifecycle each_turn is accepted but never fires. Therefore local guarded-policy success cannot be claimed as Freya behavior.
findings.adapter: Convert enforceable requirements into data availability gates, workflow transitions, tool schemas and explicit prompts, then assess speech behavior independently. Keep StreamGuard as a separate runtime target or local oracle; mark unsupported enforcement honestly.

adapter_requirements.requirement: Dedicated official workflow emitter and validator
adapter_requirements.acceptance: Bare workflow has initial_node pointing to a node-map key, official node fields, per-node transitions, no legacy edges/variables/type/data transport fields, and a reachable terminal on every realistic branch.
Every referenced semantic action resolves to exact HTTP parameters/schema and business success predicate; baked defaults and model-filled body fields are explicit; missing bindings fail the build.

Explicit extraction types/confidence; safe double-brace prompt substitution; ISO date conversion; per-call inputs supplied; derived values initialized; stale results reset on repeat actions. Do not rely on context_variables: the kit reports it being silently dropped (workflow-format.md:244-246).

adapter_requirements.requirement: Executable guards for writes and joins
adapter_requirements.acceptance: Separate read-back/confirmation/correction states; constraints and aggregate join success block entry to write actions; explicit string status flags; any generated code_exec reads vars, catches errors and sets fallback outputs, with no double-brace delimiters (tools-and-code.md:492-499).

Explicit interrupt priority, variable-based collection gates, business versus transport retry counts, bounded unanswered turns, reset policy and passthrough fallbacks. Preserve the brief's policy rather than copying mock counters.
Transfer and bank close operations execute with valid enums/inputs; close runs once and last; terminal farewell comes from end_call.function parameters; no unconfirmed native telephony assumptions.

Stable snake_case node keys and variable ownership; carried state is assigned explicitly; static return branches or appropriate __previous__ global returns; no undocumented dynamic targetVariable/parallel metadata.

Internal spec, bare workflow, create/update request and exported metadata wrapper remain distinct. Optional nulls removed using a write allowlist. Future deployment uses stable slots, dry-run, publish, read-back and ID persistence.

Real persona and agent IDs, customerVariablesMap, chat mode for kit practice, all event model overrides, duration/concurrency controls, configurable k and trace-based checks. Guarded offline pass and platform pass are reported separately.

local_test_suggestions.name: Confirmation, constraints and join parity
local_test_suggestions.suggestion: Use an injected in-memory tool backend to assert no write before explicit yes, changed amount/date requires new confirmation, rejected approval stops the action, and every required check succeeded before the join. local_test_suggestions.name: Retry budgets and interrupt precedence
local_test_suggestions.suggestion: Exercise wrong versus malformed security answers, unanswered collection turns, transient transport failure, success resets, and escalation combined with slot completion. local_test_suggestions.suggestion: Record in-memory action calls for normal, transfer, verification failure, wrong number, paid and refusal paths. Assert valid queue/outcome/reason, one close_call, no bank action after close, and a reachable end_call with intended farewell.

local_test_suggestions.suggestion: Test raw generated dialogue independently of StreamGuard, then compare guard-on results. Flag requirements that pass only because the local guard blocked speech; do not label those as deployed Freya guarantees.

limitations: No implementation, network calls, server dry run, publication, persona creation or platform simulation was performed.
The base sample's exported nulls conflict with the documented no-null write rule; use write normalization and report the discrepancy rather than treating a read artifact as a validated request.
Native telephony transfer, invoke_agent, optional persona agentIds and the legacy unit-test endpoint/schema are outside the confirmed local subset.
